prompt_text: Use the first transparent source contact sheet as six references in reading order, two columns by three rows. Preserve exact row mapping: row 1: Obsidian spire (highlands-obsidian-spire); row 2: Sulfur vent (highlands-sulfur-vent); row 3: Cooled lava boulder (highlands-cooled-lava-boulder); row 4: Volcanic ruined arch (highlands-volcanic-ruined-arch); row 5: Cave wall straight (caverns-cave-wall-straight); row 6: Cave wall corner (caverns-cave-wall-corner). The second transparent center-dot image indicates exact 6 columns by 6 rows; do not reproduce dots. Columns FRONT, TOP, RIGHT, LEFT, BOTTOM, REAR. Spire top/bottom show small cross-section/footprint, with the tall vertical spire occluded when looking along Z; side views carry height. Sulfur vent top shows opening and surrounding rock; bottom rock base. Boulder shows rock footprint and underside. Ruined arch top is arch footprint, underside underside of stone span. Cave-wall straight and corner show long or L-shaped footprints in top/bottom and thickness in side elevations. Strict axis-aligned orthographic, not isometric/three-quarter. Front and rear broad elevations; right/left side elevations. TOP camera looks straight down along Z at footprint; BOTTOM straight up along Z at underside, occluding vertical height. Preserve source identities, palette, materials, shapes and proportions. One complete centered object per cell, no duplicates or neighbors. Transparent background, no text, labels, lines, grid, border, scenery or shadow; no clipping/leakage. Unseen surfaces conservatively inferred, not recovered pixels.
